<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Disallow line breaks inside interpolation by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24742
* Detect managed Homebrew and delayed package feeds by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24739
* Disable all RuboCop extension suggestions by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24748
* Update receipts when a redirect renames a tap by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24600
* uninstall: skip unavailable cask formula deps by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24738
* info: look up installed kegs once for dependents by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24744
* linkage_checker: fail CI run on undeclared_deps by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24741
* brew.sh: reject download domains that look like options by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24756
* update-report: validate update revisions by @carlocab in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24757
* cleanup: keep downloads of casks named like another cask's URL by @DIYgod in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24758
* Stop recursing through tap migration loops by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24761
* Load `timeout` where `Timeout` is used by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24759
* Clarify brew fetch platform options by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24768
* Show why Git's version check failed by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24766
* Show download locations in verbose brew fetch by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24767
* Check cask receipts before loading tap definitions by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24765
* Keep Git cache revision checks offline by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24771
* Show curl failure output and support older curl by @iMichka in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24754
* rubocops: add audit_depends_on for iterating every matching dep by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24776
* Preserve API name indexes on no-op updates by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24788
* Untap with broken formulae and untrusted casks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24781
* Prepare formula bump PRs for later publication by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24782
* Prepare cask bump PRs for later publication by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24792
* Forget a tap's Git HEAD when clearing its cache by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24799
* Keep failed cask upgrades retryable by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24780
* Refresh cask records after app self-updates by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24786
* style: count tap callers once across symlinks by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24779
* vulns: recognise fixes in upstream releases by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24789
* Speed up macOS tests and test-bot CI runs by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24791
* cask_loader: restore formula deps from receipt by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24785
* Fix prepared bump version and branch checks by @nandahkrishna in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24794
* Test cycle and self-dependency guards in `Dependency.expand` by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24801
* workflows/tests: drop unused Codecov token by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24798
* Skip missing test tools under brew test-bot by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24795
* dev-cmd/tests: move Sorbet ENV handling before API by @samford in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24810
* Scope download credentia

detail.readme: # 🍺 Homebrew [![Latest GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/Homebrew/brew.svg)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/releases) [![BSD-2-Clause License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Homebrew/brew)](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/LICENSE.txt) [![GitHub Sponsors](https://img.shields.io/github/sponsors/homebrew?label=GitHub%20Sponsors)](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew) [![Open Collective backers and sponsors](https://img.shields.io/opencollective/all/homebrew?label=Open%20Collective)](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) See [Homebrew's homepage at `brew.sh`](https://brew.sh) for installation instructions, what homebrew does, packages, `brew bundle` and more. ## 💸 Donations Homebrew is a non-profit project run entirely by volunteers, not employees. We need your funds to pay for software, hardware and hosting around continuous integration and future improvements to the project. Every donation will be spent on making Homebrew better for our users. Please consider a regular donation through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew), [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/homebrew) or [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/homebrew). Read about [sponsoring Homebrew](https://docs.brew.sh/Sponsoring-Homebrew). Homebrew is fiscally hosted by the [Open Source Collective](https://opencollective.com/opensource). ## 📚 Documentation Read the Homebrew manual with [`man brew`](https://docs.brew.sh/Manpage). Read [installation](https://docs.brew.sh/Installation), [troubleshooting](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting), [contribution](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/docs/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request.md) including the [FAQ](https://docs.brew.sh/FAQ) on [`docs.brew.sh`](https://docs.brew.sh/). Read the [Homebrew Blog](https://brew.sh/blog/) for release notes, project updates and announcements. ## 📦 Packages Find [formulae](https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/), [casks](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/), dependencies, versions and package metadata on [`formulae.brew.sh`](https://formulae.brew.sh). View anonymised install, build and operating system usage data at [`formulae.brew.sh/analytics`](https://formulae.brew.sh/analytics/). Read how Homebrew uses [Anonymous Analytics](https://docs.brew.sh/Analytics). ## 🔧 Get Help First, please run `brew update` and run (and **read**) `brew doctor`. Second, read the [Troubleshooting Checklist](https://docs.brew.sh/Troubleshooting). **If you don't read these it will take us far longer to help you with your problem.** After this, if you still need help, please ask in [Homebrew/discussions](https://github.com/orgs/Homebrew/discussions) or follow (and **read**) the [Homebrew/brew new issue chooser](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/issues/new/choose). ## 💬 Social Follow Homebrew on [Mastodon](https://fosstodon.org/@homebrew), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/brew.sh), [𝕏 (Twitter)](https://x.com/MacHomebrew) or subscribe to the [newsletter](https://buttondown.email/homebrew). ## 🤝 Contributing We'd love you to join us and >10,000 others by contributing to Homebrew! First, please read our [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#code-of-conduct). A good starting point for contributing is: - `brew tap --force homebrew/core` or `brew tap --force homebrew/cask` (depending on whether you'd rather work on formulae or casks) - perform a strict audit on a package you use e.g. `brew audit --strict ffmpeg` for FFmpeg - if no warnings, run `brew audit --strict` to run on all packages and pick one to fix - read through the warnings and fix them until `brew audit --strict ` shows no results - [submit a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your fixes Alternatively, for something more substantial, check out one of the open issues in [Homebrew/brew](https://github.com/homebrew/brew/issues), [Homebrew/homebrew-core](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-core/issues) or [Homebrew/homebrew-cask](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-cask/issues). If you've had inspiration for a new feature or bug fix: we don't need you to open an issue first, just [open a pull request](https://docs.brew.sh/How-To-Open-a-Homebrew-Pull-Request) with your implementation and we'll review it. Good luck! ## 🔐 Security Please see [our security policy](https://github.com/Homebrew/.github/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md) for how to report security issues and what is in scope. ## 👥 Who We Are Homebrew's [Project Leader](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#project-leader) is [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid). Homebrew's [Lead Maintainers](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#lead-maintainer) are [Bevan Kay](https://github.com/bevanjkay), [Carlo Cabrera](https://github.com/carlocab), [Justin Krehel](https://github.com/krehel), [Michael Cho](https://github.com/cho-m), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Nanda H Krishna](https://github.com/nandahkrishna), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane), [Rui Chen](https://github.com/chenrui333), [Ruoyu Zhong](https://github.com/ZhongRuoyu), [Sam Ford](https://github.com/samford) and [Sean Molenaar](https://github.com/SMillerDev). Homebrew's [Security Team](https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-Governance#4-security--emergency-actions) members are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Mike McQuaid](https://github.com/MikeMcQuaid), [Patrick Linnane](https://github.com/p-linnane) and [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw). Homebrew's other Maintainers are [Andrew Nesbitt](https://github.com/andrew), [Anton Melnikov](https://github.com/botantony), [Bo Anderson](https://github.com/Bo98), [Branch Vincent](https://github.com/branchv), [Caleb Xu](https://github.com/alebcay), [Daeho Ro](https://github.com/daeho-ro), [Douglas Eichelberger](https://github.com/dduugg), [Dustin Rodrigues](https://github.com/dtrodrigues), [FX Coudert](https://github.com/fxcoudert), [Harald Nordgren](https://github.com/HaraldNordgren), [Issy Long](https://github.com/issyl0), [Klaus Hipp](https://github.com/khipp), [Markus Reiter](https://github.com/reitermarkus), [Michka Popoff](https://github.com/iMichka), [Štefan Baebler](https://github.com/stefanb), [Thierry Moisan](https://github.com/Moisan), [William Woodruff](https://github.com/woodruffw) and [hyuraku](https://github.com/hyuraku). Homebrew was originally created by [Max Howell](https://github.com/mxcl). ## 📜 License Code is under the [BSD 2-clause "Simplified" License](LICENSE.txt). Documentation is under the [Creative Commons Attribution license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). ## 💛 Sponsors Homebrew is generously supported by: - [GitHub](https://github.com/github), b.well, Codecademy, Gusto, Joshua Baer, Randy Reddig, Workbrew, ZachryWilsn, Naveen Nathan, mikadelbert, Aagam Dalal, awppatel, chellesand, EbbetG, thanvirmohamed and [many others](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew#sponsors) via [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Homebrew). - [Open Broadcaster Software](https://opencollective.com/obsproject), [Thinkst Canary](https://opencollective.com/thinkst-canary), Airbnb, Cybozu, mkvirtasant, WonderProxy, Gabor Nadai, PlanetScale, Richard Moats, Ajimah, Cameron, David Ball, emushack, Ian-Retired, J-Swift, William Hern and [many others](https://opencollective.com/homebrew/transactions?kind=ADDED_FUNDS&kind=CONTRIBUTION) via [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/homebrew). - [many others](https://www.patreon.com/homebrew) via [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/homebrew).
